items.heading: Students Search This Phrase
items.text: Students search this phrase in two very different situations. One group has Biology, wants out of the doctor track and asks "what else can I do with PCB?". The other group took PCM, calls their stream "non-medical" and wants courses that are not medicine.

items.heading: The Boundary Moves Every Year,
items.text: The boundary moves every year, so save this table and check the last column on the official page. It also shows a rare thing: two neighbouring states running the same course through opposite step.

items.heading: Most Guides Tell You "Don't
items.text: Most guides tell you "don't worry, switch to BSc" and stop. Ask a sharper question: which of the hours you already spent on Physics, Chemistry and Biology pay off on the exam you will sit next?

items.heading: Ask for the Seat, Not
items.text: Ask for the seat, not the dream. Ask your child to name the one seat they would happily take and the marks gap to it. Then check the gap table above together.

items.heading: Read the Notice for Your
items.text: Read the notice for your state. Nursing, BPT and B.Pharm rules differ by state. Read the official notice, not a WhatsApp forward.

items.heading: Price the Year, Not Just
items.text: Price the year, not just the fee. A drop year costs coaching, living and one year of delayed pay. Compare the total with your education budget.

items.heading: Keep the Loan Rule Strict
items.text: Keep the loan rule strict. Avoid education loans unless the course is legally necessary and the fee is proportionate to realistic early pay.
